verdict.rationale: Chronicle ingests production traces via its SDK or an OpenTelemetry exporter. Users can turn a trace into a task with 'Add trace', group tasks into suites, and run versioned Suite or Compare evaluations scored by code or LLM-judge scorers. The marketing site adds that production data becomes staging environments that are replayed for evaluation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of bulk dataset curation (filtering, sampling, labeling many traces at once) beyond single-trace conversion.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: Found a useful case? Choose Add trace to turn it into a task.
Use SDK trace ingestion or an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle.
A task suite groups tasks so you can run the same tests against every agent version.
Chronicle freezes the suite's current tasks and scorers into a version and pins it to the run, so later edits don't change this result.
Connect your tools, capture real conversations, and start replaying events for training and evaluation - all from your dashboard.
Write a task and attach scorers that check its requirements.
